Definition: to gleam, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; by transference to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions)
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsâhal, meaning to gleam, i.e. be cheerful. It appears 9 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 12:6 and Isaiah 54:1.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsâhal matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
